lines.en: A vast shadow slides over the seabed.
My tail pushes whole stretches of sea.
My hide rasps against the reef.
Neogene currents carry me along.
Ninety points of flesh, cruising slow.
My dorsal fin cuts the surface.
These teeth are older than the fossils.
Sand billows where I pass.
Patrolling the sea is my routine.
Fish part as I cruise through.
Deep-water dark suits me best.
No rival shares this ocean.
I push water like a ship's bow.
My teeth run right down my throat.

lines.zh: 化石遍布全球，游也游遍
lines.en: Fossils worldwide; I roam just as wide.
Circle slowly; the sea is big.
I'm longer than a boat.
One sweep carries me far.
Hanging in the deep like an island.
The current runs through my gills.
I'm waiting for you to fall in.

lines.zh: 这口牙不用，也会长回来
lines.en: Unused teeth grow back anyway.
The seabed is dark, just right.

lines.zh: 鲨鱼不会停，但我可以歇
lines.en: Sharks don't stop, but I may rest.

lines.zh: 九十点血肉，藏着多大的胃口
lines.en: Ninety points of flesh, and a matching hunger.
Distant fish don't dare come near.

lines.zh: 海水一呼一吸，我也一样
lines.en: The sea breathes, and so do I.
All I smell is old blood.
This hide is harder than the reef.

lines.zh: 我的影子压住整片海床
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole seabed.
No rush; hunters wait best.
The surface light is far above me.
You're floating right up there, perfect.
A two-legged meal that swims poorly.
I'm right below you.
Did you spot my fin?
Don't splash; that only calls me.
I can hear your heartbeat.
Have you measured these jaws?
There are no walls in water.
While you're ashore, I won't stir.
Half a second of eye contact is enough.
Thick hide, but my jaws still loosened.
That blow broke my patrol.
Blood spreads through the water.
Pain makes my tail whip.
Even in the deep I can be hit.
My hide is torn back to the flesh.
I'll remember this scent.
Hard to retreat in water; I can only turn.
Ninety points of flesh still fears pain.
Don't think size makes me uncuttable.
Drop the meat and I'll take it.
Once the blood spreads, I'm there.

lines.zh: 我不吃死东西，动着更好
lines.en: I don't care for dead things; moving is better.

lines.zh: 你拿什么逗我？那块太小
lines.en: What are you teasing me with? Too small.
I'll follow in your wake.
Come closer; my mouth is open.
That's barely enough to wet my throat.

lines.zh: 血水引来的不止我一个
lines.en: Blood draws more than just me.

lines.zh: 我会一直跟着，直到你掉下来
lines.en: I'll follow until you fall in.
Throw it far and let me chase.
The hull bumped me and rocked.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的侧腹，弹开了
lines.en: You hit my flank and bounced off.
I'm heavier than the reef.

lines.zh: 水下一撞，你的骨头会响
lines.en: One bump underwater and your bones will ring.
Don't swim alongside my fin.
My tail throws up a wave.
I turned, and you were shoved aside.
These waters are too crowded; move.
Hitting me only scrapes your skin.
I pass, and the water parts.

lines.zh: 绕着你游，一圈比一圈近
lines.en: I circle you, closer every lap.
Even the Neogene sea wants company.

lines.zh: 我的体型得配个相当的
lines.en: My size needs an equal.
Let's hunt these waters together.
A tail slap is my answer.
The deep is quiet; good for us.
You lead; I follow.
Teeth touching means I won't bite.
This sea feeds two great mouths.
Slow down, don't scare the school.
Whatever's in the water, one gulp.
Fallen meat is mine.
One gulp and it's gone.
Even bones on the seabed get chewed.
Blood has the clearest smell.
I clamp down and hold.
One bite, and the water reddens.
Anything in the water belongs to me.
I swallow slowly; no hurry.
This one fills a gap.
In the water, you're mine.
The blood smell marks your spot.
I'm speeding up; the water roars.
One bite is all it takes.
Don't head for shore; too late.
These waters answer to me.
I've locked onto your heartbeat.
My teeth are showing.
You swim far too slowly.

lines.zh: 新旧纪的顶级猎手，只挑一个
lines.en: The top hunter of the Neogene picks one.
I'm beneath you, always following.

lines.zh: 你游向哪，我的嘴就转向哪
lines.en: Wherever you swim, my jaws turn.
Deeper now; less to hide behind.
I needn't rush; you'll tire.
Circle by circle, I close in.

lines.zh: 你回头看一眼，我就在那
lines.en: Glance back; I'm right there.
The blood smell thickens.

lines.zh: 这片海没有边，你逃不远
lines.en: The sea has no edge, but you're spent.
My shadow arrives before I do.
Three more fathoms down and I reach you.
Jaws meet and the water bursts.
One bite shatters bone too.
My tail lashes and the wave turns.
This row of teeth is made for big prey.
I bite and don't release.
The water runs red.
You're dragged under.
This is prehistoric bite force.
My charge hits harder than my bite.
Calm surface, teeth below.
A dark shape splits the sea's surface.
The fin rises first.
Neogene seawater floods in.

lines.zh: 我的影子压暗了这片海
lines.en: My shadow darkens this patch of sea.
Ninety points of flesh swims into the shallows.
I'm taking over these waters.
Teeth first, then the eye.
The seabed sand is stirred up.
I arrive, and the fish scatter.
These are Megalodon's waters.
The swell parts; I surface.
Don't get in the water; listen first.
The sea is burning; I sink lower.
A whole fish dropped on hard ground.
Dead water floods my gills.

lines.zh: 爆开的水压震得我发晕
lines.en: The blast pressure stuns me.
Something has pierced my flank.
This pain burns from my gills to my bones.

lines.zh: 海里没猎物，我饿得发狂
lines.en: No prey in this sea; hunger drives me wild.

lines.zh: 雷穿过海水，我整条都麻了
lines.en: Lightning ran through the sea; I'm numb all over.
The sea is gone; I hang in the air.
